name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
oracle_text:
Each creature that's enchanted by an Aura you control can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Auras you control.
blocked_sentences: Each creature that's enchanted by an Aura you control can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.

needs.what: a static affects-filter key matching a creature that has at least one Aura attached to it whose controller is the static's controller (e.g. `enchanted_by: {"controller": "you"}`), usable on the `cant_attack_you` static so any creature, the opponents' included, enchanted by your Aura can't attack you or your planeswalkers
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_affects_filter_keys has `attached` (only the one permanent the source itself is attached to, i.e. 'enchanted/equipped creature') and `attached_to_host` (other attachments sharing the source's host); neither reads the Auras attached to an arbitrary creature or their controller, so `cant_attack_you` cannot be scoped to creatures enchanted by any Aura you control from a non-Aura source
